name: Anah
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Then the sons of Seir the Horite who inhabited the land, with their own dukes, Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. Esau learned dukes from the Horites, took the title and the land, and Seir the Hamite land became Edom.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present
